# Purpose

Use the Word format when colleagues need to revise the result without Quarto.
The reference document supplies the PHBern Word styles.

## Course link

This relative link to the
[free example resource](../resources_free/example-resource.md) becomes an
absolute website link because `_quarto.yml` defines `website.site-url`.

## Checklist

- Use semantic headings.
- Use real lists rather than typed dashes.
- Keep tables simple enough for Word.
- Add citations through the bibliography [@mayer2021].

::: {.callout-note title="Source and automatic elements"}
The [source of this Word example](https://github.com/PHBern-RConrardy/phbern-is1/blob/main/examples/word.qmd)
uses ordinary headings, lists, links, and citations. `phbern-docx` supplies the
Word styles and automatically generates the **Literatur** heading.
:::
